The Transportation Safety Board reports that the controller decided to shut down and isolate the suspected ruptured section.
case.question: Which operational team should review this incident report?

source.title: Transportation Safety Board of Canada · investigation P24H0018
source.note: The source describes an actual rupture and the control centre response. This retrospective prompt asks where a report would be reviewed; it does not reconstruct the original control room decision.
